newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: LITHUANIA-SHARE ADVANCE SLOWS AMID QUIETER MARKET.
newsitem.headline: LITHUANIA-SHARE ADVANCE SLOWS AMID QUIETER MARKET.

text.p: Lithuania's blue chips cooled down on Thursday, as brokers said key bank shares were taking a breather but expected turnover and prices to rebound.

The blue chip official list slid 13.99 points to 1079.45 points, and the wider group-A index gained 4.91 points to 1843.41 points as cenral market turnover sunk to 528,000 litas from 1.5 million litas.
Hermis Bank brought down the official list, falling to 250 litas from 265 litas in lower central market turnover of 66,000 litas.
It was expected to recover to 260 litas in coming sessions with a pickup in activity, brokers said.
"When prices go down on bank shares, buyers appear," said one dealer.
Despite lacklustre central market turnover, Hermis saw 4.9 million litas turnover in block trades at 260 litas to 266 litas.
Brokers say Vilniaus Bank, which held steady at 300 litas, may take off again and land at 310 litas or 315 litas next week.
Shares in Rokishkis Cheese, currently rising after its first-half results, advanced to 47.98 litas from 47 litas, but its central market turnover was a relatively low 39,000 litas.
Brokers say Rokishkis shares could go as high as 50 litas and expect turnover to become more active.
Brokers said they also expect advances from B-group share Mazheikiu Nafta, a 90-percent state-owned oil refinery.
Mazeikiu shares, which are traded twice a week, advanced to 12.16 litas from 11.60 litas in 79,000 litas turnover on the central market.
"The shares are quite cheap now," said one broker. "The company is doing quite well now."
